title: 'Infinite density' at the center is not an observation
summary: The v1 article states a singularity of infinite density as a feature. That is a statement about where classical general relativity breaks down.
body: The v1 article said the center of a black hole compresses matter to infinite density and that current physics breaks down there. The second half is the careful claim; the first half states a mathematical idealization as if it were a measured density. No source opened here reports an observed infinite density. Treat the sentence as unsourced interpretation until it is tied to a relativity text that distinguishes the singularity theorem from an instrument reading.
